correctness.rationale: Contracting each color's demanded equivalences gives exactly B_(n-d)/B_n for identification rank d; independent colors multiply. An uncolored tree of four worlds has three nonredundant colored demands, so the larger-component probability is O_r(m^4 rho_n^3)=o(1). On a triple, an all-one-color path closes by transitivity; a two-color path gives a wedge, with six center/leaf choices for a given color pair on each unordered triple. Extra internal identifications or outside attachments cost another Bell-ratio factor. In joint factorial moments the disjoint configurations yield the product Poisson moments; a connected overlap on v>3 worlds costs at least v-1 total rank, hence O(m^v rho_n^(v-1))=o(1), and distinct motifs on three worlds cost at least rank three. The same extra-demand bounds control the expected difference between open motif and component counts. Pair coincidences concentrate around their diverging means by the fixed Bell ratios, and only tight many are in triples. To complete the monochromatic-pair step explicitly, multiple colors on a named pair contribute in expectation binom(r,2) binom(m,2) rho_n^2=o(1); thus those pairs can be discarded. Nonisolated vertices are o_P(m). At quantifier rank q, match touched components by isomorphism, reserving a fresh one when needed; q abundant components of each type suffice while rare counts match exactly. This gives the relational first-order limit by discrete convergence of rare counts, with no nontrivial announced predicate. Below the window, all two-link witnesses have vanishing expected count. Above it, a monochromatic triple count has diverging mean with disjoint-pair moments asymptotically factorized; relative overlap terms are O(1/m + 1/(m^2 rho_n))=o(1). The finite restriction formula follows by selecting the omitted vertices attached to surviving blocks and independently partitioning the complement. Independent bounded enumeration at n=5,m=4 gives exact open motif numerators 20 and 5400 and checks one restricted partition probability (/workspace/review_checks.py, partitions). The supplied checker was inspected, not executed; it checks finite identities, not asymptotic independence or logical convergence.

evidence: Resultary 1ef5ccfacb50, §3, counts three worlds at three corners of a 2-by-2 rectangle of independent labels, with Pois(t^3) limit at N~t k^(2/3). This is the same local wedge, up to exclusions whose expected count vanishes at the window.
equivalent_formulations.reasoning: The marginal is covered after the random-alphabet reduction: the Dobiński occupancy mixture assigns alphabet size K probability proportional to K^n/K!, then labels worlds uniformly conditionally on K, yielding the uniform partition by summing (K)_b/K^n for a specified b-block partition. E[1/K]=rho_n and E[1/K^2]~rho_n^2 imply K/(1/rho_n)→1 in probability. Given K near L=floor(1/rho_n), couple shared labels of the two uniform alphabets; the disagreement probability for one pair equality is O(|K-L|/L^2). By independent colors, expected differing wedge witnesses is O(m^3/L^2) times a vanishing relative alphabet discrepancy, so the fixed-size result transfers in probability. This does not transfer any joint law not present in that result.
